name: Falcon-H1-7B-Base
attention_variant: GQA in parallel with Mamba-2 on every layer
notes: Hybrid confirmed two ways. config.json declares architectures ['FalconH1ForCausalLM'], model_type 'falcon_h1', with both Mamba-2 fields (mamba_d_state 256, mamba_d_head 128, mamba_n_heads 24, mamba_d_conv 4, mamba_chunk_size 128) and attention fields (12 query heads, 2 KV heads, head_dim 128). The safetensors index shows all 44 layers carrying self_attn.q/k/v/o_proj AND mamba.in_proj/out_proj/conv1d/A_log/D/dt_bias together - i.e. TII's 'hybrid mixer block' runs attention and SSM in PARALLEL in every layer, not the interleaved 1-in-N pattern used by Nemotron-H or Granite 4.0. This is the serving trap: the KV cache does NOT shrink. bf16 KV bytes/token = 44 layers x 2 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 x 2 bytes = 45056 B/token = 44.0 KiB/token, and at 262144 max_position_embeddings a full-length sequence is 11.00 GiB of KV per sequence at bf16 - with only 2 KV heads the per-token cost is low but the layer count is 44 so the total is still large. In parallel the recurrent state costs mamba_d_state 256 x mamba_d_head 128 x mamba_n_heads 24 = 786432 elements = 1.5 MiB per layer per sequence at bf16, x 44 layers = 66 MiB, constant in context length. rope_theta 1e11 with no rope_scaling; max_position_embeddings 262144 is 2x the next-largest in this slice. gqa_ratio = 12 / 2 = 6. Hidden 3072 with 44 layers is another deep-and-narrow shape: 44 layers at width 3072 versus 32 layers at width 4096 for Llama-3.1-8B.
